name: proxy-beta
displayName: Proxy Smart Beta — the public demo deployment
description: Explore a working SMART on FHIR authorization proxy without deploying one. Connects to the public Proxy Smart beta at beta.proxy-smart.com, a full stack (proxy, Keycloak, HAPI FHIR) with seeded demo patients, and bundles a tour skill for finding your way around it. Demo data only: it is public, shared, and reset without notice, so never put real patient data in it. For your own deployment install the `proxy` plugin instead.
